causal_chain: The Rust worker upgrade introduced a race condition in event batch processing that failed to validate message payloads before forwarding them to the normalization stage; this failure was prevented by the missing alert for payload schema drift, which was not configured during the migration and is now verified as absent in the monitoring dashboard.
remediation: Immediate fix: reconfigure the payload schema drift alert in the monitoring dashboard by June 7, with ownership assigned to Platform Engineering Lead, verified via a test run at 15:00 UTC on June 8; systemic prevention includes adding schema validation in all new consumer tiers before deployment and enforcing configuration through CLI overrides; residual risk remains if upstream endpoints emit malformed payloads, which will be caught by the existing prometheus facade metrics; follow-up diagnostics to validate alert coverage are not yet run.
